sentences.japanese: 英国人は法と秩序を大いに尊重する。
sentences.english: The British have a lot of respect for law and order.

sentences.japanese: われわれは権力を憎むが法と秩序の必要は認める。
sentences.english: While we hate force, we recognize the need for law and order.

sentences.japanese: どの社会で暮らすにも、法を守らなければなりません。
sentences.english: We all must abide by laws to live in any society.

sentences.japanese: どの社会で暮らすにも、法を守らなくてなりません。
sentences.english: We all abide by law to live in any society.

sentences.japanese: そんな法に従わなくてもよい。
sentences.english: You don't have to obey such a law.
